name: Plan Product Launch
summary: Plan a staged product launch with readiness gates, audience sequencing, ownership, and recovery.
description: Plan a product or feature launch across readiness, positioning, enablement, channels, operations, measurement, and rollback. Use when a release needs coordinated market activation rather than a date-driven announcement checklist.
refuses: It does not publish, deploy, notify customers, promise dates, or spend budget without authorization.
It does not hide known defects, availability limits, pricing terms, or operational risk.
It does not call announcement reach a successful launch without adoption and quality evidence.
